Select compounds that are selective for JAK2 (CHEMBL2971) over JAK1 (CHEMBL2835). Define two deduplicated compound sets and intersect them: (1) JAK2 hit set: compounds with an IC50 activity row against target CHEMBL2971 where standard_relation = '=', standard_units = 'nM', and standard_value < 50. (2) JAK1 hit set: compounds with an IC50 activity row against target CHEMBL2835 where standard_relation = '=', standard_units = 'nM', and standard_value > 200. Deduplicate each set by molregno before intersecting so that no compound appears more than once. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN) to get canonical_smiles. Return exactly two columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
